card.name: Last digit of round numbers
card.fires_on: The final digit of a multi-digit number, such as the 4 in 24 hours, the 0 in 100 mL or 60 mL, or the 8 in 48 hours. It also fires on 'per' in 'copies per mL'.

modes.label: Last digit before units
modes.description: The closing digit of a number right before a unit such as hours, mL, or mg.
modes.example: remove YCANTH with soap and water prior to 2<<4>> hours after treatment

modes.label: Per before mL
modes.description: The word 'per' in a concentration just before mL.
modes.example: HIV-1 RNA less than 50 copies<< per>> mL
